pages.title: Arbor Simulacrum
pages.text: A complete simulation of the World Tree, branch by branch, universe by universe, running inside a lattice small enough to carry. Every possible universe grows on it, and every one is real enough to compute. Looking into it is like looking down from a great height.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)The Omnilex Engine needed to understand the Tree to control it. It simulated the Primordial Ocean under a Primordial Law, and from that the Tree grew in simulation, one branch at a time.

Made in $(item)Omnilex Engine$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): The Axiomatic Breach.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Absolute Infinity, Arbor Simulacrum, Axiom Key, Bubble Universe, Omega Point, Omnilex, Omnilex Seal, Pocket Universe and more.
